events.title: Homecoming Kickoff Rally
events.description: Ignite school spirit and launch the homecoming season with full-force energy! Highlighting live student DJs, food trucks, pep rally drums, and official giveaways. Dress in our school colors!

events.title: Career Fair Networking Night
events.description: Establish crucial connections for summer internships and entry-level positions. Interact with recruiters from top engineering, consulting, and creative agencies. Resume printouts required.

events.title: International Student Mixer
events.description: Welcome and integrate international students into campus life. Enjoy speed-networking icebreakers, sample foods from different continents, and find your local support networks.

events.title: Blue Bears Season Opener
events.description: Witness the Blue Bears battle their arch-rivals in the first match of the college basketball tournament. Free foam fingers for the first 100 students!

events.title: Greek Yard Show
events.description: The step performance tradition returns! Watch campus fraternities and sororities showcase complex stepping, high-energy dancing, and chapter chants.

events.title: STEM Innovation Expo
events.description: Explore research projects, hardware builds, and custom coding prototypes developed by students. Network with judges from tech companies and see live 3D printing.

events.title: Student Government Town Hall
events.description: Speak directly with your student body representatives. Voice opinions on housing services, cafeteria hours, and allocations of student organization budgets.

events.title: Wellness & Mental Health Workshop
events.description: Decompress from classes with mindfulness exercises, meditation guides, and complimentary yoga. Take home wellness kits and healthy snacks.

events.title: BSA Cultural Gala Night
events.description: Celebrate legacy and heritage with music, performance poetry, history displays, and fashion. A signature annual celebration for student groups.

events.title: Friday Night Kickback
events.description: Wind down after midterms with board games, free pizza, game consoles, and casual conversations in a low-stakes environment.

events.title: Blue Bears Basketball Game
events.description: Come support the Blue Bears in our season opening basketball game! Free entry for all students with school ID.

events.title: Varsity Tennis Match
events.description: Our varsity tennis team takes on the state champions. Refreshments will be served.

events.title: Intramural Soccer Finals
events.description: The final game of the intramural soccer tournament. Who will take home the trophy?

events.title: Homecoming Football Game
events.description: The biggest game of the year! Join thousands of alumni and students for the annual Homecoming Football Game.

events.title: Homecoming Concert & Dance
events.description: Celebrate Homecoming with a live concert featuring guest student DJs and local bands.

events.title: Alumni Tailgate Party
events.description: Connect with alumni, enjoy free food and drinks, and get ready for the game.

events.title: Annual Fall Career Fair
events.description: Meet recruiters from over 100 companies hiring for internships and full-time jobs.

events.title: Tech Resume Review
events.description: Get your resume reviewed by senior engineers and hiring managers before the career fair.

events.title: Mock Interview Blitz
events.description: Practice your interview skills with real-time feedback in this fast-paced mock interview event.

events.title: STEM Club Code & Coffee
events.description: Bring your laptop, grab a cup of coffee, and work on your coding projects with fellow STEM students.

events.title: Creative Writing Workshop
events.description: Unleash your creativity. Participate in writing prompts, share your work, and get constructive feedback.

events.title: UI/UX Design Masterclass
events.description: Learn the principles of modern interface design. Perfect for aspiring product designers and developers.

events.title: Freshman Welcome Rally
events.description: Welcome to campus! Meet your class, learn about campus traditions, and kick off your college journey.

events.title: Campus Scavenger Hunt
events.description: Explore the campus, solve clues, and win prizes with your orientation group.

events.title: President's Ice Cream Social
events.description: Enjoy free ice cream and mingle with the university president, faculty, and staff.

events.title: Acoustic Sunset Session
events.description: Relax to live acoustic music as the sun sets. Featuring talented student singer-songwriters.

events.title: Battle of the Bands
events.description: Campus bands face off for a grand prize and the chance to open the spring music festival.

events.title: Jazz Ensemble Fall Show
events.description: An evening of classic and contemporary jazz performed by the university jazz ensemble.

events.title: Welcome Back Neon Rave
events.description: Light up the night! Join us for a high-energy neon rave with laser shows and electronic music.

events.title: Halloween Costume Ball
events.description: Spooky season is here. Dress in your best costume and join us for dancing, treats, and contests.

events.title: Astronomy Club Stargazing
events.description: View planets, star clusters, and nebulae through high-powered club telescopes.

events.title: Chess Club Open Tournament
events.description: Test your strategy. Open to all skill levels from beginners to grandmasters.

events.title: Distinguished Lecture Series
events.description: An intellectual discussion featuring guest speakers exploring cutting-edge scientific innovations.

events.title: Undergraduate Research Symposium
events.description: See the impressive research posters and presentations by student researchers across all disciplines.

promotions.description: Same-day certified repair on campus: cracked screen replacements, degraded battery swap-outs, keyboard cleaning, and data recovery for all laptops & phones.

promotions.description: Low-maintenance air-purifying dorm room plants: pothos cuttings, monsteras, mini snake plants, and terracotta pots. DM for drop deliveries.

promotions.description: 100% natural soy wax candles hand-poured in small batches. Signature scents: Vanilla Lavender, Eucalyptus Rain, and Warm Amber Cashmere. Perfect dorm gifts.

promotions.title: Spanish & French Conversational Fluency Practice
promotions.description: Native speaker conversational tutoring to prepare for oral finals, study abroad trips, or language proficiency testing. Relaxed 45-minute practice chats.
